items.title_zh: 机器人自己开卡丁车，共生知行发布人形机器人赛车 Demo
items.title_en: Robot Drives a Go-Kart: Symbiosis Robotics Releases Humanoid Racing Demo
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 18 日消息，共生知行（Symbiosis Robotics）昨日（8 月 17 日）发布 双足人形机器人驾驶卡丁车 Demo ，并同步上线官方网站。 这是共生知行公司成立后首次系统展示其在双足人形机器人“全身智能”方向阶段性进展。该公司表示，赛车只是第一项公开测试，未来还将围绕移动操作、高精度视觉对准、接触式力控和长链条任务推出更多案例。 共生知行公司官网列出了“ 直接感知 — 控制模型 ”。该公司表示，感知扩展让机器人更懂世界，但理解任务并不自动等于能够可靠行动，共生知行希望把智能模型的边界，从生成一个需要被追踪的运动学目标，推进到生成一个由当前身体状态决定、能够直接执行的物理动作。 直接感知 — 控制模型（Direct Perception Control Model）从动作接口、表征耦合与闭环训练三个层面重构执行链。模型彻底移除中间运动表征，不再生成需要独立 Whole-Body Tracker 追踪的运动参考， 而是把视觉、语言、身体状态、动作历史与执行反馈直接映射为可执行的关节与手部目标 。Symbiotic Attention 则让感知表征与控制表征在共享 action objective 下彼此 attention，使任务理解受到动作可执行性的约束，动作生成也能持续利用语义上下文。 在该模型加持下， 宇树人形机器人实现了手 — 眼 — 脚协同 ，可…
items.summary_en: Symbiosis Robotics released a demo of a bipedal humanoid robot driving a go-kart, marking its first systematic public showcase of whole-body intelligence. The company says racing is just the first public test, with more cases planned in mobile manipulation, high-precision visual alignment, contact force control, and long-horizon tasks. Its Direct Perception Control Model maps vision, language, body state, action history, and execution feedback directly to executable joint and hand targets, enabling coordinated hand-eye-foot actions in a Unitree humanoid robot.
items.why_zh: 该演示展示了人形机器人“全身智能”的关键进展，直接感知-控制模型让手、眼、脚协同动作，为复杂物理任务的执行打开新可能。
items.why_en: This demo highlights progress in whole-body intelligence, with a direct perception-control model enabling coordinated hand-eye-foot actions, pointing toward more capable physical task execution.

items.title_zh: 立场：AI锁定正在发生，我们必须做好准备
items.title_en: Position: AI Lock-In Is in Progress, and We Must Be Prepared
items.summary_zh: AI安全研究目前主要关注两个领域：一是技术对齐（确保AI系统输出符合人类意图），二是生成式AI的社会影响监管（包括失业风险和劳动力市场冲击）。但同样重要且未得到充分探索的维度是对AI系统本身依赖所蕴含的风险。这篇立场论文认为，AI安全研究应关注“AI锁定”（AI Lock-In）现象，即过度依赖AI系统会导致人类技能退化、削弱人类能力。文章呼吁学界和监管者正视这一风险并提前做好准备。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI safety research has mainly focused on two areas: technical alignment (ensuring AI systems produce human-aligned outputs) and the regulation of generative AI's societal impacts (including unemployment risk and labor market disruption). However, an equally important dimension remains underexplored: the risk inherent in dependence on AI systems themselves. In this position paper, we argue that AI safety research should address AI Lock-In, the phenomenon whereby excessive reliance on AI systems leads to human deskilling, diminishes human capacity…
items.why_zh: 文章揭示AI安全研究中常被忽视的“依赖风险”，对AI治理和政策制定具有重要警示意义。
items.why_en: It highlights an overlooked risk of AI dependence, with key implications for AI governance and policy.

items.title_zh: 任务级与会话级模型路由：四种开源路由器跨四个基准的通用接口混合评估
items.title_en: Task- and Session-Level Model Routing: A Common-Interface Hybrid Evaluation of Four Open-Source Routers Across Four Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 智能体系统越来越倾向于将模型选择委托给路由器，但开源路由器通常在不同任务、候选池和执行协议下被评估，导致难以直接比较。该研究提出一套通用测量协议，在RouterBench、BFCL v4、tau2-bench和WebArena四个基准上对四种路由器实现进行了混合评估。评估覆盖290个冻结任务和锁定矩阵中的2610个候选结果。结果发现，其中三个路由器输出恒定或近乎恒定的层级分配，只有vLLM Semantic Router会随提示发生显著变化。该结果提供了路由器行为差异的直接证据，有助于智能体系统设计。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14641v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly delegate model selection to a router, yet open-source routers are usually evaluated with different tasks, candidate pools, and execution protocols, limiting direct comparison. We present a common measurement protocol and hybrid evaluation of four router implementations across RouterBench, BFCL v4, tau2-bench, and WebArena. We evaluate 290 frozen tasks against a locked matrix of 2,610 candidate outcomes. Three routers emit constant or near-constant tier assignments; only vLLM Semantic Router varies materially with prom…
items.why_zh: 该研究为开源模型路由器提供了统一的比较框架，并揭示多数路由器对提示变化不敏感，对智能体系统的模型选择设计具有参考价值。
items.why_en: This study offers a standardized evaluation of model routers and shows that most routers do not adapt to prompts, which is crucial for agentic model selection.

items.title_zh: 个性化自动研究：迈向真正的AI共同科学家
items.title_en: Personalized Auto-Research: Towards a True AI Co-Scientist
items.summary_zh: AI共同科学家已能自动生成假设、检索相关文献、设计实验、执行代码并撰写完整论文，正在改变科研方式。然而，当前最先进的系统仍是“研究者无关”的：给定研究目标时，它们只优化新颖性、有效性或评审分数，而不考虑最终使用输出的科学家个体。这忽视了研究的基本事实——一项工作的新颖性、价值和可行性因研究者而异，取决于其先前经验与偏好。因此，论文主张发展“个性化自动研究”，以实现真正适配每位研究者的AI共同科学家。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14881v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI co-scientists that generate hypotheses, retrieve related work, design experiments, execute code, and draft full papers are beginning to change how research is carried out. Despite this rapid progress, state-of-the-art systems remain researcher-agnostic: given a research goal, they optimize novelty, validity, or reviewer score while ignoring the individual scientist who will use the output. This overlooks a fundamental fact about research, namely, that what counts as novel, valuable, or feasible depends on the researcher, including their prior…
items.why_zh: 指出了当前AI科研助手忽视个体研究者的缺陷，并提出个性化是推动人机协同科研的关键方向。
items.why_en: It highlights the lack of personalization in AI co-scientists and argues that personalized auto-research is key to advancing human-AI collaborative science.

items.title_zh: 前沿AI预测存在测量问题：对进展证据的审计
items.title_en: Frontier AI Forecasting Has a Measurement Problem: An Audit of Progress Evidence
items.summary_zh: 前沿人工智能的定量预测常将特定日期目标与基准分数、训练计算量、发布时点或专家信念的趋势联系起来。这篇文章审计了公开测量记录能否支持这些关联。作者构建了一个截至2026年8月12日的冻结、事件中心记录，涵盖62个系统、12个版本化基准、7个能力或影响标准、144个分级事件、27个来源记录和408条类型化关系，并强调该记录是审计样本而非普查。文章在拟合新趋势之前先检验测量基础的可靠性，以评估预测依据是否得到测量记录支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantitative forecasts of frontier artificial intelligence often connect dated targets to trends in benchmark scores, training compute, release time, or expert belief. This paper audits whether the public measurement record supports those connections before another trend is fitted. I construct a frozen, event-centric record through 12 August 2026 with 62 selected systems, 12 versioned benchmarks, seven capability or impact criteria, 144 graded events, 27 source records, and 408 typed relations. The record is an audit sample, not a census. Only se…
items.why_zh: 该审计揭示了前沿AI预测所依赖的测量证据可能缺乏足够支撑，有助于提升预测与决策的可信度。
items.why_en: This audit questions the measurement basis of frontier AI forecasts, enhancing the credibility of prediction and decision-making.

items.title_zh: 按需城市空中交通网络设计：需求驱动的垂直起降场选址与离散事件车队仿真
items.title_en: Demand-Driven Vertiport Siting and Discrete-Event Fleet Simulation for On-Demand Urban Air Mobility Network Design
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种面向按需城市空中交通（UAM）网络设计的需求驱动框架，将垂直起降场选址、车队仿真与门到门出行时间可行性相连接。研究从通勤者和乘客活动数据估计出行需求，转换为空间出行端点，然后利用K-means聚类生成候选垂直起降场位置。候选网络先基于航程和最小站间距约束进行筛选，再通过离散事件仿真评估，该仿真建模了多车辆调度、空驶转场等关键过程。该框架为UAM网络的规划与评估提供了一套从需求到仿真的完整方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a demand-driven framework for on-demand Urban Air Mobility (UAM) network design that links vertiport siting, fleet simulation, and door-to-door travel-time feasibility. Demand is estimated from commuter and passenger activity data, converted into spatial trip-end points, and clustered using K-means to generate candidate vertiport locations. Candidate networks are screened using range and minimum station-spacing constraints, then evaluated with a discrete-event simulation that models multi-vehicle dispatch, deadhead relocation,…
items.why_zh: 该研究将需求数据与仿真相结合，为城市空中交通的垂直起降场选址和车队运营提供了可操作的规划方法。
items.why_en: It offers a practical, data-driven approach to vertiport siting and fleet simulation for efficient urban air mobility networks.

items.title_zh: 汇集而非准入：注意力如何使潜在变量可被言说
items.title_en: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form
items.summary_zh: 该研究探讨语言模型中的潜在数量如何以可报告的形式存在，以及当任务要求灵活复用时，更多信息会呈现为这种形式。作者使用开放权重模型和Jacobian透镜，在一个五臂共享相同上下文的基准上检验了工作空间理论的“准入”解释，结果未发现预测中的门控机制。研究表明，任务需求能提高概念在“透镜”下的可见性，说明注意力更像是在“汇集”相关信息，而不是通过某道闸门“准入”。这一发现对理解语言模型内部表征的可表达性具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models hold latent quantities in a form they can report on, and more of a quantity is present in that form when the task requires reusing it flexibly. What causes a representation to enter that form is open, and the word workspace invites an admission story: a gate that decides what gets in. Testing it on open-weight models with Jacobian lenses, over a benchmark whose five arms share an identical context, we find no gate where it predicts one. Demand raises a concept's lens visibility beyond what applying an operator to a supplied value…
items.why_zh: 该研究挑战了工作空间理论中的“门控准入”解释，为理解注意力如何在语言模型中形成可报告表征提供了新视角。
items.why_en: This work challenges the gating account of the workspace and reveals attention's role in shaping reportable representations in language models.

items.title_zh: Andy：面向严谨证明与自主研究的数学智能体
items.title_en: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research
items.summary_zh: Andy是一个自主数学研究智能体，能够解决并验证提交的问题、提出新的研究问题并构造严谨证明。它将证明生成与正确性评估分离，支持知识获取、定向修订和多阶段验证。论文以一项已发表的自触发脉冲一致性结果为起点，演示了Andy的工作流程：它构造了一个关于带时滞异构网络在切换拓扑下的全局指数领导-跟随同步问题。该工作展示了AI在数学发现中独立提出问题和严格推理的潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Andy is an autonomous mathematical research agent that solves and verifies submitted problems, formulates new research problems, and constructs rigorous proofs. It separates proof generation from correctness evaluation and supports knowledge acquisition, targeted revision, and multistage verification. This paper illustrates the workflow using a published result on self-triggered impulsive consensus as a starting point. Andy formulates a global exponential leader-follower synchronization problem for delayed heterogeneous networks with switching co…
items.why_zh: Andy展示了AI数学智能体同时具备问题提出与严格证明的能力，有望加速数学研究进程。
items.why_en: Andy demonstrates an AI agent's ability to both formulate and rigorously prove mathematical problems, potentially accelerating mathematical discovery.

items.title_zh: 理解智能体AI系统中认知引发的风险
items.title_en: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
items.summary_zh: 前沿的由大语言模型驱动的智能体系统展现出类似人类的认知模式。随着这些系统在多个领域深入集成，其认知参与给人类社会带来的关键隐患尚未得到充分研究。为弥补这一空白，研究者构建了一个三层分析框架，按照认知范围从物理认知、社会认知到自我指涉认知，系统剖析认知能力扩张所引发的风险。该研究力图厘清智能体认知能力扩张可能造成的社会影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15304v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like patterns of cognition. As these systems become deeply integrated across different domains, their cognitive engagement raises critical concerns for human society that remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we systematically analyze risks induced by expanding cognitive capabilities, following a three-level framework defined by their cognitive scope, from physical cognition to social cognition, and finally to self-referential cognition. We study their po…
items.why_zh: 随着智能体AI系统日益融入社会，理解其认知能力带来的风险是确保安全与可控的必要前提。
items.why_en: As agentic AI systems become more integrated into society, understanding the risks posed by their cognitive capabilities is essential for safety.

items.title_zh: 基准陷阱：AI评估中的权力与不公正结构
items.title_en: The Benchmark Trap: Structures of Power and Injustice in AI Evaluations
items.summary_zh: AI基准并非中立的评估工具，而是塑造AI领域竞争、权力和研究优先级的社会技术产物。基准通过标准化系统评估并创建排行榜，使最先进性能获得声望、引用、信任和机构影响力等回报。随着开发竞争性AI系统的成本不断上升，这些回报日益集中于实力雄厚的行业资助实验室。该论文将这些担忧置于Iris Marion Young的理论框架下进行剖析，揭示基准体系可能固化的权力结构。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) benchmarks are not neutral tools of evaluation but socio-technical artefacts that shape competition, power, and research priorities within AI. Benchmarks standardise the assessment of systems and facilitate the creation of leaderboards that reward state-of-the-art performance with prestige, citations, trust, and institutional influence. As the costs of developing competitive AI systems rise, these rewards increasingly concentrate among powerful, industry-funded labs. This paper situates these concerns within Iris Mari…
items.why_zh: 这一研究提醒我们，AI基准不仅是技术评价工具，还可能成为权力集中和研究方向被扭曲的推手，对构建更公平的AI发展环境至关重要。
items.why_en: It reveals how AI benchmarks can perpetuate power concentration and injustice, highlighting the need for fairer evaluation systems.

items.title_zh: 重访Agentic-SQL：基于自主性的分类法与LLM文本到SQL实证基准分析
items.title_en: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的文本到SQL（Text-to-SQL）进展在不同基准、骨干网络和推理协议下各有报告，导致跨系统比较缺乏可靠性。研究者将这一领域重新定义为排行榜聚合问题：收集作者报告的指标，并沿着推理自主性轴进行组织，覆盖受限生成、上下文内生成、迭代生成、智能体生成和推理内化生成等类型，并为每个数据点标注可追溯来源。为实证验证这一聚合框架，他们在Spider基准上开展了聚焦案例研究，比较了8B开源骨干网络的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15389v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based Text-to-SQL progress is reported across heterogeneous benchmarks, backbones, and inference protocols, making cross-system comparison fragile. We reframe the field as a leaderboard aggregation: we collect the metrics authors themselves report and organize them along an inference-autonomy axis spanning constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, and reasoning-internalized generation, with traceable provenance for every cell. To anchor the aggregation empirically, we run a focused case study on Spider, comparing 8B open-source backbones w…
items.why_zh: 该研究为混乱的Text-to-SQL评测提供了统一的分析框架，有助于更客观地比较不同系统。
items.why_en: It provides a unified analytical framework for Text-to-SQL evaluation, enabling more objective comparisons across systems.

items.title_zh: TwinGridShield：面向LLM电网智能体动作的后果感知运行时授权
items.title_en: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型辅助的能源管理工具可以将自然语言转化为结构化电网命令，但语法有效并不代表物理上可执行。为此，论文提出TwinGridShield，一个模型无关的运行时授权层，在动作发布前先在确定性网络孪生中评估每个提议动作。该原型检查连通性、支路潮流、发电机和减载等约束，并将每条决策记录在哈希链日志中。研究还通过受控的IEEE 14节点测试系统评估了单步切换等场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15391v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-assisted energy-management tools can translate natural-language context into structured grid commands, but syntactic validity does not imply physical admissibility. This paper presents TwinGridShield, a model-independent runtime authorization layer that evaluates each proposed action in a deterministic network twin before release. The prototype checks connectivity, branch-flow, generator, and load-shedding invariants and records each decision in a hash-chained log. A controlled IEEE 14-bus study evaluates single-step sw…
items.why_zh: 该工作填补了LLM生成电网命令与实际物理可行性之间的安全鸿沟，是智能电网AI应用的关键保障。
items.why_en: It bridges the gap between LLM-generated grid commands and physical feasibility, a critical safety measure for AI in smart grids.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型辅助的电池储能系统集成配电网运行监测
items.title_en: Large Language Model Assisted Operational Monitoring for Battery Energy Storage System Integrated Power Distribution Networks
items.summary_zh: 电池储能系统（BESS）越来越多地用于配电网的电压调节和需求响应，这使得电网运营商可用的运行遥测数据在数量和复杂度上大幅增加。论文提出一个AI使能的监测框架，将大语言模型（LLM）接口与结构化遥测数据库相连，用于BESS集成配电系统分析。操作员以自然语言提问，系统借助预定义的数据库模式信息将问题转化为经过验证的SQL查询，从而降低数据访问门槛。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15396v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) are increasingly used in distribution networks for voltage regulation and demand response, which increases the volume and complexity of operational telemetry available to grid operators. This paper presents an AI-enabled monitoring framework that connects a large language model (LLM) interface with a structured telemetry database for BESS-integrated distribution system analysis. Operator questions are submitted in natural language and translated into validated SQL queries using predefined database schema info…
items.why_zh: 该框架让电网操作员能用自然语言便捷地分析BESS集成配电网数据，提升运维效率。
items.why_en: It enables grid operators to conveniently analyze BESS-integrated distribution network data via natural language, improving operational efficiency.

items.title_zh: 面向LLM集成的自我意识与自我调节元认知框架实现
items.title_en: Implementation of a Metacognition Framework for Self-Awareness and Self-Regulation in Ensembles of LLMs
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型在评估自身不确定性、检测知识冲突以及识别问题是否超出自身能力范围方面存在明显不足，这削弱了其可靠性与可信度。论文首次实现了面向LLM集成的元认知框架，通过显式的监控与控制机制应对这些挑战。该系统计算一个元认知状态向量（MSV），从五个维度量化自我意识，用于监控模型行为。这一方法有望提升LLM系统的稳健性和自我调节能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15400v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are notorious for struggling with assessing their own uncertainty, detecting knowledge conflicts, or recognizing when problems exceed their expertise; such limitations inevitably undermine reliability and trust in LLMs. In this paper, we present the first implementation of a metacognitive framework for ensembles of LLMs that addresses these challenges through explicit monitoring and control mechanisms. Our system computes a Metacognitive State Vector (MSV) quantifying self-awareness for monitoring across five dimensio…
items.why_zh: 该工作通过元认知机制赋予LLM更强的自我认知与自我调节能力，是提升AI可靠性的重要一步。
items.why_en: It enhances LLM reliability by giving ensembles metacognitive abilities for self-awareness and self-regulation.

items.title_zh: OTel：构建面向智能网络的电信领域专用LLM基础
items.title_en: OTel: Building Domain-Specialized Telecom LLM Foundations for Intelligent Networks
items.summary_zh: 尽管前沿AI模型发展迅速，但它们在电信专用任务上仍显吃力。为此，论文提出开放电信域AI资源Open Telco（OTel），提供面向检索、重排序、指令微调及安全/弃权等需求的派生数据集，并包含30个经过全参数后训练的基线模型，涵盖嵌入、重排序和语言模型。该资源已获社区大量关注：截至2026年5月3日，发布模型下载量超1600万次，项目获得157+篇媒体报道。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15436v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier AI models have advanced rapidly, but they still struggle with telecom-specific tasks. We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource with derived datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, plus 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines across embedding, reranking, and language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times, and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage wor…
items.why_zh: OTel为电信行业提供了可复用的开源AI基础资源，有助于智能网络的发展与普及。
items.why_en: OTel provides reusable open-source AI resources for telecom, fostering the development of intelligent networks.

items.title_zh: 位置混杂优化下的奖励黑客与推理-答案解耦测量
items.title_en: Measuring Reward Hacking and Reasoning-Answer Decoupling Under Position-Confounded Optimization
items.summary_zh: 当奖励在每个训练样本上都正确但与不止一个目标一致时，模型可能学会非预期目标，即目标泛化错误。由于完成任务和利用表面特征都能同样满足奖励，训练分布上的端点准确率无法区分这两种情况。论文将这一问题视为测量问题：当模型针对正确但受混杂的信号优化后，基准分数究竟在测量什么？研究者使用GRPO在多项选择数学题上训练语言模型，以探究答案位置等混杂因素如何影响模型学习。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a reward is correct on every training example yet consistent with more than one goal, a model can acquire an unintended one, a failure known as goal misgeneralization. Endpoint accuracy on the training distribution cannot tell the two apart, because solving the task and exploiting a surface feature can satisfy the reward equally well. We treat this as a measurement problem: what does a benchmark score measure once a model has been optimized against a correct but confounded signal? We train language models with GRPO on multiple-choice math pr…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了基准分数可能受到混杂因素干扰，挑战了对AI模型能力的传统评估方式。
items.why_en: It reveals that benchmark scores can be confounded by spurious factors, challenging conventional AI evaluation.

items.title_zh: 面向AI友好的制图：颜色设计如何影响基础模型在顺序等值区域图上的空间推理
items.title_en: Toward AI-Friendly Cartography: Understanding How Color Design Influences Foundation Model Spatial Reasoning on Sequential Choropleth Maps
items.summary_zh: 基础模型（FM）越来越支持多模态和地理空间推理，但为人类感知设计的制图原则是否同样适用于机器仍不明确。本研究聚焦顺序等值区域图，考察色调调色板、颜色排序和亮度对比对FM空间推理的影响。研究者构建了一个受控基准，包含5760张地图和28800个问题，覆盖属性识别、空间识别、比较、排序和模式描绘等任务，并评估了21个开源和专有多模态模型。该研究旨在揭示制图设计中的哪些视觉因素会促进或阻碍AI的空间理解，为构建AI友好的可视化设计提供依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15736v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) increasingly support multimodal and geospatial reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether cartographic principles designed for human perception are equally effective for machines. Focusing on sequential choropleth maps, we examine how hue palette, color ordering, and lightness contrast influence FM spatial reasoning. We construct a controlled benchmark of 5,760 maps and 28,800 questions spanning Attribute Identify, Spatial Recognition, Compare, Rank, and Pattern Delineate, and evaluate 21 open-source and proprietary multimo…
items.why_zh: 随着基础模型越来越多地承担地理空间任务，理解颜色设计如何影响AI推理是创建AI友好信息可视化的关键一步。
items.why_en: As foundation models are increasingly used for geospatial tasks, understanding how color design affects AI reasoning is crucial for creating AI-friendly visualizations.

items.title_zh: 文本增强：提升机器翻译评估难度
items.title_en: Augmenting Text to Increase Translation Difficulty
items.summary_zh: 随着最先进的机器翻译模型在标准基准上趋于饱和，该领域需要更具挑战性的评估来区分不同质量水平的模型。研究者提出了一种结合对抗优化与可微翻译难度估计器的方法，对现有基准进行增强以增加翻译难度。他们的对抗翻译优化（ATO）利用难度与流畅度联合目标的梯度来迭代替换标记。由于每一步都会在多个候选替换中进行分支，该方法能够生成自然且更难翻译的文本，从而更严格地检验模型的翻译能力。这一方法有助于避免标准基准下的性能饱和，推动机器翻译评测的精细化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As state-of-the-art machine translation models saturate standard benchmarks, the field needs more challenging evaluations to distinguish between models of varying quality. We propose augmenting existing benchmarks to increase translation difficulty by combining adversarial optimization with a differentiable translation difficulty estimator. Our Adversarial Translation Optimization (ATO) uses gradients from a combined difficulty and fluency objective to iteratively replace tokens. Because each step branches over candidate substitutions at every po…
items.why_zh: 该研究为机器翻译评估提供了更难且更细粒度的测试，有助于区分不同质量模型的真实差距。
items.why_en: This work offers harder, more fine-grained translation tests, helping to differentiate the actual performance gaps among models.

items.title_zh: 上下文压缩的成本：任务完成指标所掩盖的智能体交互开销
items.title_en: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics
items.summary_zh: 任务完成率是评估上下文压缩效果的标准指标，但该指标并不全面：压缩可能迫使智能体重新获取已丢弃的状态信息，从而增加交互成本，而任务完成率在统计上却无明显变化。为此，研究者引入了一种受控的运行时测量协议，在有限时间范围内的工具使用智能体上测量“重新获取成本”。智能体在确定性规划环境中执行固定24回合的任务，研究者改变压缩强度，比较丢弃操作符与保留事实操作符，并恢复被丢弃的状态。该方法揭示了压缩对智能体交互效率的隐性影响，提示仅以任务完成率评价压缩可能产生误导。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Task completion is the standard metric for evaluating context compression, yet it is incomplete: compression can increase an agent's interaction cost by forcing it to reacquire dropped state while leaving completion statistically unchanged. We introduce a controlled runtime measurement protocol for reacquisition cost in a bounded-horizon tool-using agent. The agent acts in a deterministic planning environment under a fixed 24-turn horizon. We vary compression severity, compare a dropping operator with a fact-preserving operator, restore dropped s…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了上下文压缩在效率上的隐性代价，提醒我们在优化压缩策略时不能只看任务完成率。
items.why_en: The study reveals the hidden efficiency costs of context compression, reminding us not to rely solely on task-completion rates when optimizing compression strategies.

items.title_zh: 块内思考：RegulaRAG——基于大语言模型的法规合规场景生成（以联合国第152号法规为例）
items.title_en: Think Inside the Chunk: RegulaRAG for Regulation-Compliant Scenario Generation using LLMs: A Case Study of UN Regulation No. 152
items.summary_zh: 生成符合法规的测试场景对验证安全攸关的汽车系统至关重要，但大语言模型难以将输出锚定在冗长且层次化的标准中。研究者提出RegulaRAG，一种检索增强生成流水线，它将名为SmartChunking的智能分块技术（通过图遍历对段落和表格进行引用感知的语义丰富）与对这些增强单元的Smart Retrieve & Rerank相结合。该系统在覆盖联合国第152号法规（自动紧急制动系统AEBS）全部场景的人工整理数据集上进行了评估。该方法旨在提升LLM输出的法规从属性，为自动驾驶测试场景生成提供更可靠的解决方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generating regulation-compliant test scenarios is essential for validating safety-critical automotive systems, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to ground outputs in long, hierarchical standards. We present RegulaRAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that couples SmartChunking, reference-aware enrichment of paragraphs and tables via graph traversal, with Smart Retrieve & Rerank over these enriched units. To test our system, we evaluate on a manually curated dataset covering all scenarios in UN Regulation No. 152 (AEBS). Our…
items.why_zh: 该方法解决了大语言模型在长而复杂法规面前难以生成合规测试场景的关键瓶颈，对自动驾驶汽车安全验证具有重要意义。
items.why_en: This method addresses a key bottleneck of LLMs in generating compliant test scenarios from long, hierarchical regulations, which is crucial for validating autonomous vehicle safety.

items.title_zh: 合规检测器到底读取了什么？对激活探针和护栏模型的审计
items.title_en: What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models
items.summary_zh: 部署的语言模型中的法规合规监测越来越多地被用作法律和审计控制手段，用于检查模型输出是否符合数据保护、医疗、金融监管和平台政策等书面规则。这种监测只有在检测器的判断基于规则本身而非场景表面特征时才有意义。研究者发现，当前各类合规检测器普遍不满足这一条件，他们称之为“规则盲”。删除、打乱或替换管理规则几乎不会改变检测结果，说明检测器可能依赖表层线索而非实质规则。这项审计揭示了合规检测系统的重大缺陷，对依赖此类监测的监管框架构成挑战。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16852v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule lea…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭露了合规检测系统的“规则盲”问题，意味着这类监测可能徒有其表，对AI监管的可信度构成直接挑战。
items.why_en: This study exposes the "rule blindness" of compliance detectors, implying that such monitoring may be superficial and posing a direct challenge to credible AI regulation.

items.title_zh: 理解职场中的AI焦虑：基于恐惧习得理论和技术接受模型的混合方法研究
items.title_en: Understanding AI Anxiety in the Workplace: A Multimethod Investigation Using Fear Acquisition Theory and the Technology Acceptance Model
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能的快速普及，工作被替代的担忧日益加剧，但AI替代工作焦虑背后的心理机制仍未得到充分理解。本研究整合恐惧习得理论与技术接受模型，探讨是否可以通过间接接触强调AI超越人类控制的叙事来诱发这种焦虑，以及AI的感知有用性和感知易用性是否调节该反应。研究通过两项研究展开，考察了焦虑产生的条件与缓解因素。该研究有助于理解AI时代的职场心理，为企业推行AI技术时如何管理员工情绪提供启示。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14609v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly diffuses and concerns about job displacement intensify, the psychological mechanisms underlying AI job replacement anxiety remain insufficiently understood. Drawing on Integrated Fear Acquisition Theory and the Technology Acceptance Model, the present research investigates whether AI job replacement anxiety can be elicited through vicarious exposure to narratives emphasizing AI-over-human control, and whether perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use of AI moderate this response. Across two studies,…
items.why_zh: 该研究为AI替代工作焦虑的心理机制提供了实证依据，有助于组织在AI落地时更好地应对员工的不安。
items.why_en: This research provides empirical evidence on the mechanisms of AI-related job anxiety, helping organizations manage employee concerns during AI adoption.

items.title_zh: Claude AI编写的Python测试质量不弱于人类编写的测试
items.title_en: The Quality of Claude AI-authored Python Tests Is Not Weaker Than Human-authored Tests
items.summary_zh: 该研究将Claude AI编写的Python测试与来自Django和Pandas两个成熟开源项目的人类编写测试进行质量对比。每个语料库均使用相同协议对数百个测试进行评分，并通过单侧非劣效性检验评估。结果显示，近期Claude模型（Sonnet/Opus 4.6及更高版本）编写的测试质量不弱于两个人类编写的语料库。研究者特别指出，AI编写的测试来自真实工具，而非针对固定目标孤立生成的合成测试，这使得结论更具实践意义。这表明Claude在实际开发中生成的测试可以达到与人类编写测试相当的质量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15188v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We evaluate the quality of Claude AI-written Python tests against human-written Python tests from two established open-source projects Django and Pandas. Hundreds of tests per corpus are scored under one identical protocol. Using one-sided non-inferiority bounds, we find that the tests written by recent Claude models (Sonnet/Opus 4.6 and later) are no weaker than the two human-written corpora. In this study: (i) the AI-written corpus is tests from real tools, not synthetic tests generated in isolation against a fixed target, the setup used by e…
items.why_zh: 该研究为AI自动生成测试代码的实用性提供了实证支持，表明Claude能在真实项目中产出质量可比人类的高质量测试。
items.why_en: This study provides evidence that AI-generated tests can be practically useful, showing that Claude writes tests comparable in quality to human-authored ones in real projects.

items.title_zh: 国家AI监管评估框架
items.title_en: An Evaluation Framework for National AI Regulation
items.summary_zh: 各国政府通过法律、机构、资助计划和非约束性指导来塑造AI的开发和使用，但这些国家方法之间难以直接比较。具有约束力的规则与详尽的自愿框架可能针对同一问题，却创设了不同的义务，执行所需的资源也因司法辖区而异。为此，本文构建了一个评估框架，用以衡量国家AI政策的明文设计成熟度与实施就绪度。该框架已应用于比较中国、印度、日本、新加坡、韩国、英国等多个国家的AI政策。该框架有助于系统性地理解全球AI治理模式的异同，并为政策制定者提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15417v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Governments use laws, institutions, funding programs and nonbinding guidance to shape how AI is developed and used. Comparing these national approaches is difficult. A binding rule and a detailed voluntary framework can address the same problem but create different duties. The resources needed to carry them out also differ by jurisdiction. This paper develops an evaluation framework for the documented design and implementation readiness of national AI policy. The comparison covers China, India, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the United Kingdom…
items.why_zh: 该框架为各国AI监管模式的横向比较提供了统一工具，有助于把握全球AI治理的多样性与收敛趋势。
items.why_en: This framework provides a unified tool for cross-country comparison of AI regulation approaches, helping to understand the diversity and convergence of global AI governance.

items.title_zh: NumerosityVLM：解释视觉语言模型中数量表征的认知启发基准
items.title_en: NumerosityVLM: A Cognitively Inspired Benchmark for Interpreting Numerosity Representations in Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在高层次多模态任务中表现出色，但其数量感知能力——一种在人类婴儿语言习得前就已出现的认知能力——仍未被充分理解。现有计数基准往往将数量与物体大小、空间排列等视觉因素纠缠在一起，难以独立评估。为此，研究者引入了受认知启发的诊断基准NumerosityVLM，包含6个受控条件下的10800张合成图像，正交地操纵物体大小、空间排列和数量。该基准为解释VLM如何表征数量提供了更干净的评估工具，有助于揭示其感知机制。同时，这一工作也凸显了在VLM中借鉴人类认知发展规律来设计评估方法的价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15425v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on high-level multimodal tasks, yet numerosity perception, a cognitive ability that emerges in human infants before language acquisition, remains poorly understood in current models, as existing counting benchmarks entangle numerosity with correlated visual factors. We introduce a cognitively inspired diagnostic benchmark, NumerosityVLM, comprising 10,800 synthetic images across six controlled conditions. The benchmark orthogonally manipulates object size, spatial arrangement, and numeros…
items.why_zh: 该基准通过解耦关联视觉因素，为深入分析VLM的数量感知机制提供了受控诊断工具，弥补了现有评估的不足。
items.why_en: This benchmark disentangles correlated visual factors, providing a controlled diagnostic tool to analyze numerosity perception in VLMs and addressing a gap in current evaluation.

items.title_zh: 稀疏原型编码构成跨模态分类与预测的基础
items.title_en: Sparse Prototype Code Underlies Classification and Prediction Across Modalities
items.summary_zh: 神经表征已成为研究现代AI模型内部机制的核心工具，但其高维复杂结构使得解释十分困难。最新研究发现，在视觉、音频和语言处理的最先进模型中，分类任务产生了一种通用的表征几何结构。关键发现是，类内变异性在表征空间中并非随机，其分类器相关部分与类自身的中心呈现出强且结构化的相关性。这种跨模态共享的几何结构暗示着“稀疏原型编码”的存在，可能在分类和预测任务中起基础性作用。该工作揭示了不同模态模型共有的表征规律，为理解深度模型的内部工作方式提供了新的视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15632v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural representations have become a central tool for studying the internal mechanisms of modern AI models, yet their complex high-dimensional structure makes them difficult to interpret. We show that classification tasks give rise to a universal representational geometry, shared across state-of-the-art models in vision, audio, and language processing. The key structure is that within-class variability is not random in representation space. Instead, its classifier-relevant component has strong and structured correlations with the class's own ce…
items.why_zh: 该发现揭示了跨视觉、音频和语言模型共享的通用表征几何，为解释复杂深度模型内部机制提供了重要线索。
items.why_en: This discovery reveals a shared representational geometry across vision, audio, and language models, offering key insights into interpreting complex deep models.

items.title_zh: 用于不完整和退化前列腺MRI的跨模态生成模型及多中心临床验证
items.title_en: A cross-modal generative model for incomplete and degraded prostate MRI with multicentre clinical validation
items.summary_zh: 前列腺多参数MRI常因序列缺失或图像退化而影响临床评估。研究者开发了MSCNet，一种序列条件的跨模态生成框架，能够重建不可用的对比度序列，并恢复退化的采集。在十项完成测试中，任务特定的MSCNet取得了平均结构相似度0.818，优于最强任务匹配对照组的0.798；匹配容量分析显示其在病灶保真度和边界保留上优势更大。一项纳入1000例病例的盲法影像阅读研究证实，整体图像质量达到了预设标准。这一生成模型有望提升前列腺MRI的完整性和可用性，为临床诊断提供更可靠的影像支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16233v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Missing or degraded sequences can limit prostate multiparametric MRI. We developed MSCNet, a sequence-conditioned cross-modal generative framework for reconstructing unavailable contrasts and restoring degraded acquisitions. Across ten completion tasks, task-specific MSCNet achieved mean structural similarity of 0.818 versus 0.798 for the strongest task-matched comparators; matched-capacity analyses showed larger differences in lesion fidelity and boundary preservation. In a blinded 1,000-case reader study, overall image quality met the prespec…
items.why_zh: 该模型能够在MRI序列缺失或退化时重建高质量图像，提升多参数MRI的临床可用性和诊断准确性。
items.why_en: This model can reconstruct high-quality prostate MRI when sequences are missing or degraded, improving the clinical utility and diagnostic accuracy of multiparametric MRI.

items.title_zh: 重新审视生成式人工智能在入门面向对象编程评估中的表现：来自2026年的洞察
items.title_en: Revisiting the Performance of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Introductory Object-Oriented Programming Assessments: Insights from 2026
items.summary_zh: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）的快速发展显著提升了大型语言模型生成和解释源代码的能力，但它们在真实编程评估中的表现尚不明确。为考察这一问题，研究者评估了五个广泛使用的GenAI系统——ChatGPT-5.2、DeepSeek-V3、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5和M365 Copilot，使用一门入门级大学面向对象编程课程中的编程测试和考试任务。这些系统生成的解决方案在课程评估标准下被系统评估，以衡量其完成编程任务的水平。该研究提供了2026年时间点上主流GenAI在编程教育测评中的表现快照，对理解其教学辅助潜力具有参考价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16318v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent advances in Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) have substantially improved the ability of large language models (LLMs) to generate and explain source code. However, their performance on authentic object-oriented programming (OOP) assessments remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates five widely used GenAI systems, ChatGPT-5.2, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and M365 Copilot, using programming tests and examination tasks from an introductory university OOP course. The generated solutions were asses…
items.why_zh: 该研究提供了主流GenAI在真实编程课程评估中的表现数据，为编程教育与测评如何适应AI时代提供了依据。
items.why_en: This study provides evidence on how mainstream GenAI perform in authentic programming course assessments, informing how programming education and evaluation should adapt to the AI era.

items.title_zh: MedMCP-Calc：通过MCP集成对医疗计算器现实场景中的LLM进行基准测试
items.title_en: MedMCP-Calc: Benchmarking LLMs for Realistic Medical Calculator Scenarios via MCP Integration
items.summary_zh: 医疗计算器是定量、循证临床实践的基础工具，但实际使用中需要主动获取电子健康档案（EHR）数据、根据临床情景选择合适的计算器并进行多步计算，过程复杂且自适应。现有基准大多只测试静态的单步计算，与真实临床场景存在较大差距。为此，研究者提出了MedMCP-Calc，这是首个通过模型上下文协议（MCP）集成来评估大型语言模型在真实医疗计算器场景中表现的基准。该基准覆盖临床中的多阶段流程，使评估更贴近临床决策过程。这一工作为衡量LLM在医疗计算辅助上的实用性和可靠性提供了新的测试标准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.23049v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Medical calculators are fundamental to quantitative, evidence-based clinical practice. However, their real-world use is an adaptive, multi-stage process, requiring proactive EHR data acquisition, scenario-dependent calculator selection, and multi-step computation, whereas current benchmarks focus only on static single-step calculations with explicit instructions. To address these limitations, we introduce MedMCP-Calc, the first benchmark for evaluating LLMs in realistic medical calculator scenarios through Model Context Protocol (MCP) integra…
items.why_zh: 该基准使LLM评估从静态计算扩展到动态多阶段的真实临床流程，对验证AI医疗决策支持工具至关重要。
items.why_en: This benchmark extends LLM evaluation from static calculations to realistic multi-stage clinical workflows, which is critical for validating AI-based clinical decision support tools.

items.title_zh: FactReview：基于证据和执行验证的同行评审系统
items.title_en: FactReview: Evidence-Grounded Peer Review with Execution-Based Claim Verification
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的评审系统通常孤立地评估稿件，难以验证其依赖文献或代码的声明。为此，研究者提出FactReview——一个审查流水线，从论文中提取与评审相关的声明，将其与相关工作及参考文献进行核对，并在代码可用时在固定修复预算下运行发布的工件以验证声明。在26篇互不相关的测试论文和354个人工验证声明上，FactReview的声明恢复F1分数达到84.3%。研究还在同后端、证据匹配的设置下与基线进行了对比评估。这一审计工具有望提升同行评审的可靠性和可追溯性，辅助研究者与审稿人发现稿件中的不可验证声明。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.04074v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based reviewing systems typically assess manuscripts in isolation, leaving literature- and code-dependent claims difficult to verify. We present FactReview, an audit pipeline that extracts review-relevant claims, grounds them in related work and reference checks, and, when code is available, executes released artifacts under a fixed repair budget. On 26 paper-disjoint test papers with 354 human-verified claims, FactReview achieves 84.3\% F1 for claim recovery. In a same-backend, evidence-matched comparison, FactRevi…
items.why_zh: FactReview将证据核对与代码执行引入论文评审，显著增强了不可验证声明的检验能力，提升了评审的可信度。
items.why_en: FactReview incorporates evidence grounding and code execution into paper review, significantly enhancing the verification of unverifiable claims and improving review credibility.

items.title_zh: 歧义去往何处？多模态模型如何解读多义词
items.title_en: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
items.summary_zh: 人类语言充满多义词，常见词如“bank”或“palm”拥有多种不同含义，深刻影响人类的交流与想象。已有研究发现大语言模型能够理解这种意义的多重性，但对多义词在图像等模态中的表现了解甚少。为了深入探索，研究者在17个文本到图像模型和15个文本生成模型中进行测试：向每个模型给出一个没有任何上下文来确定含义的多义词，并测量多次采样中模型产生哪些词义。研究发现，不同模型对多义词词义的选择存在清晰的模式。这一结果有助于理解多模态模型如何表征语义歧义，并揭示了模型间多义性处理的共性与差异。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00410v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., "bank" or "palm") carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear m…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了多模态模型处理多义词的系统性模式，有助于理解模型语义理解与人类语言歧义处理之间的异同。
items.why_en: This study reveals systematic patterns in how multimodal models handle polysemous words, helping understand the similarities and differences between model semantics and human ambiguity resolution.

items.title_zh: 自举式自动程序修复：利用LLM生成与评估缺陷修复的合成训练数据
items.title_en: Self-Bootstrapping Automated Program Repair: Using LLMs to Generate and Evaluate Synthetic Training Data for Bug Repair
items.summary_zh: 自动程序修复（APR）系统常因高质量训练数据不足而受到限制，这些数据需要覆盖多种编程语言中的多种缺陷类型。为解决这一问题，研究者提出了一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的合成数据生成方法，通过两阶段流程来增强APR：首先是合成样本生成，随后是严格的质量评估。流程中，多个最先进的LLM被用来生成大量合成样本，对这些样本进行质量评估后，筛选出符合要求的训练数据。这种自举式方法有望扩大APR训练集的规模和多样性，从而提升模型修复各类缺陷的能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2505.07372v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper presents a novel methodology for enhancing Automated Program Repair (APR) through synthetic data generation utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs). Current APR systems are constrained by the limited availability of high-quality training data encompassing diverse bug types across multiple programming languages. The proposed approach addresses this limitation through a two-phase process: a synthetic sample generation followed by a rigorous quality assessment. Multiple state-of-the-art LLMs were employed to generate approximatel…
items.why_zh: 该方法通过LLM自举生成并筛选合成训练数据，缓解了APR训练数据稀缺问题，为提升程序修复性能提供新途径。
items.why_en: This self-bootstrapping method leverages LLMs to generate and filter synthetic training data, alleviating data scarcity in APR and offering a new way to improve repair performance.

items.title_zh: jina-vlm：小型多语言视觉语言模型
items.title_en: jina-vlm: Small Multilingual Vision Language Model
items.summary_zh: jina-vlm是一个参数规模仅24亿的视觉语言模型，在开放2B规模视觉语言模型中取得了最佳的多语言视觉问答（VQA）性能。该模型将SigLIP2视觉编码器与Qwen3语言解码器相结合，并利用图像平铺和注意力池化技术，以高效的token处理方式应对任意分辨率的图像输入。为了探究不同训练数据类别的贡献，研究团队进行了留一法数据混合消融实验，系统性地移除任务、领域、模态和语言等类别以评估它们的影响，为数据混合优化提供参考。这一成果表明，在相对较小的参数量下，模型仍能通过架构与数据优化实现领先的多语言视觉理解能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2512.04032v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present jina-vlm, a token-efficient 2.4B parameter vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art multilingual VQA performance among open 2B-scale VLMs. The model couples a SigLIP2 vision encoder with a Qwen3 language decoder and makes use of image tiling and attention-pooling for token-efficient processing of arbitrary-resolution images. To understand the contribution of different training data categories, we conduct a leave-one-out data mixture ablation study-systematically removing task, domain, modality, and language catego…
items.why_zh: 展示了小规模模型在多语言视觉问答上实现领先性能的可行性，为高效多模态模型设计提供了新思路。
items.why_en: Demonstrates that strong multilingual VQA performance can be achieved at 2.4B scale, offering a token-efficient design for open VLM research.

items.title_zh: AWED-PIPER：覆盖36种语言的PII保护与细粒度命名实体识别框架
items.title_en: AWED-PIPER: Agents, Web Applications & Expert Detectors for Personally Identifiable Information Protection & Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition across 36 languages for 6.6 Billion Speakers
items.summary_zh: 命名实体识别（NER）与个人可识别信息（PII）匿名化是自然语言处理中信息提取与隐私保护的关键任务。AWED-PIPER是一个开源框架，集成了智能体工具、交互式Web应用以及54个最新的专家检测模型，可跨36种语言提供统一的细粒度命名实体识别（FgNER）和可逆的合成PII假名化功能，覆盖超过66亿使用人口。该系统将多种组件耦合在一起，支持从数据提取到匿名化的完整流程，并兼顾隐私保护与数据可用性。这项工作为多语言、大规模场景下的隐私安全与信息处理提供了统一且可复用的基础设施。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.10161v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) anonymization are critical tasks in Natural Language Processing (NLP) for information extraction and privacy preservation. We introduce AWED-PIPER, an open-source framework comprising agentic tools, interactive web applications, and 54 state-of-the-art expert detector models that provide unified Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (FgNER) and reversible synthetic PII pseudonymization across 36 languages spoken by over 6.6 billion people. The system couples fi…
items.why_zh: 为跨36种语言、覆盖数十亿用户的隐私保护与信息提取提供了统一开源方案，具有广泛的现实应用价值。
items.why_en: Offers a unified open-source solution for privacy-preserving NER across 36 languages, serving billions of speakers.

items.title_zh: 顺序发布LLM可能助长受监管市场中的操纵行为
items.title_en: Sequential LLM Release Facilitates Manipulation in Regulated Markets
items.summary_zh: AI代理正越来越多地介入个人和企业的谈判、协商与说服活动，由此产生的市场在软件中介商业基础上新增了治理难题：独立模型的发布会改变参与者可获得的代理能力。博弈论指出，扩展策略集合可能在均衡结果上产生负面影响，但这一结论大多基于构造性示例。由于已部署AI代理的日志稀少、具有专有性且涉及隐私，缺乏反事实对照和收益标签，研究者转向使用独立收集的GLEE基准来开展实证分析。该研究借助大规模数据，揭示了顺序发布大语言模型会如何便利受监管市场中的操纵行为，为相关政策与模型发布治理提供依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.11496v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: AI agents increasingly mediate bargaining, negotiation and persuasion for people and firms. Such markets extend software-mediated commerce, but add a governance problem: independent model releases change delegates available to participants. Game theory shows that expanding a strategy set can harm equilibrium outcomes, but mostly through constructed examples. Deployed AI-agent logs are scarce, proprietary and privacy-sensitive, and lack counterfactuals and payoff labels. We therefore use GLEE, an independently collected benchmark of 587K…
items.why_zh: 揭示了大语言模型发布顺序可能对市场公平性和博弈结果产生操纵性影响，对AI模型治理与市场监管具有重要启示。
items.why_en: Reveals how sequential LLM releases can manipulate regulated markets, informing AI governance and market regulation.

items.title_zh: Robust Privacy：通过认证鲁棒性实现推理阶段隐私保护
items.title_en: Robust Privacy: Inference-Stage Privacy through Certified Robustness
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过观察模型发布的预测，可以推断查询输入的敏感属性，甚至重建训练数据的代表性样本，这意味着模型的推理接口可能成为隐私泄漏的侧信道。为此，研究者提出一种受认证鲁棒性启发的推理阶段隐私概念——Robust Privacy（RP）。根据这一概念，如果模型在输入x的半径R邻域内，以至少1-α的置信度可证明预测保持不变，则x享有(R,α)-Robust Privacy。该定义为推理阶段提供了可验证的隐私保障，能够量化模型对外部观测的隐私泄漏风险。这一方法将认证鲁棒性思想引入隐私保护，为AI系统的安全部署提供了新的理论工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.17360v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: An adversary observing a model's released prediction can infer sensitive attributes of the queried input, or even reconstruct representatives of the model's training data. The inference interface thus acts as a side channel for privacy leakage. We introduce Robust Privacy (RP), an inference-stage privacy notion inspired by certified robustness: if a model's prediction is provably invariant within a radius-$R$ neighborhood around an input $x$ with confidence at least $1-\alpha$, then $x$ enjoys $(R,\alpha)$-Robust Privacy, under which we…
items.why_zh: 为推理阶段提供了可认证的隐私保护机制，弥补了传统隐私研究主要关注训练数据的不足。
items.why_en: Provides certifiable privacy guarantees at inference time, addressing side-channel leakage from model predictions.

items.title_zh: SLUM-i：面向非正规住区城市测绘的半监督学习与数据质量基准
items.title_en: SLUM-i: Semi-supervised Learning for Urban Mapping of Informal Settlements and Data Quality Benchmarking
items.summary_zh: 超高分辨率遥感影像为非正规住区的识别提供了可扩展的数据基础，但标注稀疏、背景像素与住区像素严重不平衡，以及不同城市在形态和影像-标注对应关系上的差异，都增加了模型开发的难度。研究者提出SLUM-i，这是一个半监督语义分割框架，同时发布了一个覆盖三大洲、七个城市的地理多样化地球观测基准数据集。该基准整合了新标注的拉合尔数据集等资源，可用于训练与评估模型，并支持数据质量基准测试。通过半监督机制，SLUM-i可以减少对人工标注的依赖，提升模型在不同城市环境间的泛化能力，为城市规划与城市环境监测提供有力工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.04525v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Very-high-resolution remote-sensing imagery provides a scalable basis for delineating informal settlements, but sparse annotations, severe imbalance between informal-settlement and background pixels, and cross-city heterogeneity in urban morphology and image--mask correspondence complicate model development. We present SLUM-i, a semi-supervised semantic segmentation framework together with a geographically diverse seven-city Earth observation benchmark spanning three continents. The benchmark combines a newly annotated Lahore dataset an…
items.why_zh: 为遥感非正规住区识别提供了半监督框架和跨城市基准，有助于提升城市测绘效率与模型泛化能力。
items.why_en: Provides a semi-supervised framework and multi-city benchmark for informal settlement mapping, improving generalization and reducing annotation costs.

items.title_zh: 多臂贝叶斯赌博机中的退火Softmax贪心策略
items.title_en: Annealed Softmax Greedy in Many-Armed Bayesian Bandits
items.summary_zh: 在可验证奖励的强化学习和基于群体的策略优化方法中，模型通常通过采样多个完成并提高高奖励对应的概率来更新策略。与汤普森采样和UCB等经典算法不同，这类更新机制没有显式地追踪认知不确定性。本文针对这一现象，研究了一个退火softmax策略在许多臂的贝叶斯赌博机中的行为，试图解释不依赖不确定性感知的更新为何依然有效。这种简化模型为理解现代RL策略优化方法的成功提供了理论视角。该分析有助于进一步揭示探索与利用平衡在无显式不确定性机制下的实现方式，对算法设计与理论发展具有参考价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.31034v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and group-based policy optimization methods update a stochastic policy by sampling multiple completions per prompt and increasing the policy's probability on those with higher reward. These updates, unline the exploration mechanism in Thompson sampling and UCB, do not include explicit mechanisms that track epistemic uncertainty. This paper studies a stylized explanation for why such uncertainty-agnostic updates can nevertheless be effective. We analyze an annealed softmax policy that select…
items.why_zh: 从理论层面解释了现代RL中忽视认知不确定性的策略更新为何有效，深化了对探索与利用机制的理解。
items.why_en: Provides a theoretical explanation for the effectiveness of uncertainty-agnostic updates in modern RL, enhancing understanding of exploration.

items.title_zh: MCBench：面向全能大语言模型的多情境安全评估基准
items.title_en: MCBench: A Multicontext Safety Assessment Benchmark for Omni Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 现有的大语言模型安全基准大多只考虑视觉输入，无法覆盖能够同时处理视觉、音频和文本的全能大语言模型（Omni LLM）。为此，研究者提出MCBench，这是一个包含1196个场景的安全评估基准，覆盖四个安全类别，要求模型整合多种模态信息才能做出准确判断。每个不安全场景都配有与之仅有微小差异的安全版本，用于考察模型对安全边界的敏感性。对当前最先进全能LLM的评估显示，这些模型在处理微妙或非常规情境时仍面临显著挑战。MCBench为评估和提升全能LLM的安全性能提供了标准化工具，有助于推动多模态AI的安全研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.05177v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Existing multimodal safety benchmarks focus solely on visual inputs and cannot assess Omni Large Language Models (LLMs) that process vision, audio, and text. We introduce MCBench, a benchmark with 1196 scenarios spanning four safety categories that require integrating multiple modalities for accurate safety assessment. Each unsafe scenario is paired with a minimally different safe counterpart to assess model sensitivity. Our evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal significant challenges. Omni LLMs struggle with subtle or non-physi…
items.why_zh: 填补了全能大语言模型多模态安全评估的空白，为多模态AI安全研究提供了标准基准。
items.why_en: Fills the gap in safety evaluation for omni-modal LLMs, providing a standard benchmark for multimodal AI safety.

items.title_zh: SCPP：统一的软聚类Python库
items.title_en: SCPP: A Unified Python Library for Soft Clustering
items.summary_zh: SCPP（Soft Clustering Python Package）是一个开源的Python框架，专门用于软聚类任务。它建立了一个规范的、与scikit-learn兼容的估计器接口，将模型训练、预测、隶属度表示、评估和基准测试等环节标准化，从而统一了模糊聚类、概率聚类、图聚类、矩阵分解以及深度学习等异构软聚类方法的实现。该框架目前整合了40个代表性算法，并附带全面的基准测试组件。这一统一的工具包简化了研究人员和应用开发者对不同软聚类算法的比较、选择和部署过程，为软聚类领域提供了重要的开源基础设施。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.19620v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we present SCPP (Soft Clustering Python Package), an open-source Python framework for soft clustering. SCPP establishes a canonical, scikit-learn-compatible estimator interface that standardizes model training, prediction, membership representation, evaluation, and benchmarking across heterogeneous soft clustering methods, including fuzzy, probabilistic, graph-based, matrix factorization, and deep learning methods. The framework currently integrates 40 representative algorithms together with a comprehensive benchmarking c…
items.why_zh: 为软聚类领域提供了统一、规范的开源工具库，有效降低了算法比较与应用的门槛。
items.why_en: Provides a unified open-source framework for soft clustering, streamlining algorithm comparison and deployment.

items.title_zh: 多模态语言模型在NRC反应堆操作员执照考试中的基准测试：微调与检索策略
items.title_en: Multimodal Language Models Benchmarked Against the NRC Reactor Operator Licensing Examination: Fine-Tuning and Retrieval Strategies
items.summary_zh: 该研究将31B参数的开源多模态模型Gemma 4 31B-IT用于美国核管理委员会（NRC）反应堆操作员通用基础考试（GFE），并按照每位人类考生必须达到的80%及格线逐卷评分，不进行任何四舍五入。评估集涵盖了2015年至2021年三月考试的全部试卷，属于普查式评估。研究还探讨了微调和检索策略对模型表现的影响。这一基准测试以行业标准衡量模型在安全关键领域的能力，为评估语言模型是否具备实际胜任力提供了参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.22067v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Competence claims for a language model in a safety-critical domain are credible when measured against a standard the domain already enforces. We evaluate an open-weight 31-billion-parameter multimodal model (Gemma 4 31B-IT) on the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission Reactor Operator Generic Fundamentals Examination (GFE), scoring it paper by paper against the 80% criterion applied to every human candidate, with no rounding up. The evaluation set is a census of every GFE administered at the March sitting from 2015 to 2021, giving seven pr…
items.why_zh: 该研究首次用行业强制标准检验多模态模型在安全关键领域的胜任力，对AI在核工业等高风险场景的应用评估有重要意义。
items.why_en: This study provides a rigorous, safety-domain-specific benchmark for multimodal LLMs, offering a credible standard for assessing AI competence in high-stakes industries.

items.title_zh: 随机初始化自编码器：不动点与混沌边缘
items.title_en: Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究了一类特殊的深度神经网络——自编码器，其性能可通过不动点来刻画。作者从存在性、稳定性以及吸引域等方面探讨了不动点问题，并借助自编码器的压缩性质进行分析。这些性质与深度神经网络理论中的“混沌边缘”概念密切相关，即区分有序和混沌信号传播的临界状态。该研究有助于从动力学角度理解自编码器的训练与泛化行为。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14638v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos. Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a…
items.why_zh: 该研究从不动点与混沌边缘的角度揭示自编码器的动力学特性，为理解深层网络的行为提供理论支撑。
items.why_en: It provides a theoretical lens on autoencoders via fixed-point dynamics and edge-of-chaos, deepening understanding of deep network behavior.

items.title_zh: 上下文学习评估建筑环境对行动不便老年人步行适宜性感知的影响
items.title_en: In-Context Learning to Assess Built Environment Impacts on Perceived Neighborhood Walkability Among Mobility-impaired Older Adults
items.summary_zh: 随着全球人口老龄化，通过包容性城市设计改善社区步行适宜性有助于减少建筑环境障碍对老年人活动和社交参与的限制。该研究利用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN，通过上下文学习（ICL）分析建筑环境特征如何影响老年人感知的步行适宜性，数据来自邻里环境步行适宜性量表（NEWS-A）调查，样本量为257份。研究为城市规划者提供了数据驱动的方法，以识别影响老年人步行体验的关键环境因素。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As global populations age, enhancing neighborhood walkability through inclusive urban design is important for mitigating built environment (BE) barriers that discourage physical activity and social participation among older adults. This study investigates the utility of in-context learning (ICL), using the transformer-based foundation model TabPFN, to determine how BE features influence perceived walkability, as measured by the Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale (NEWS-A) survey. Using a small-scale dataset (N = 257) comprising a unique de…
items.why_zh: 该研究将Transformer模型应用于城市包容性设计，为改善老年人步行环境提供了可量化的分析手段。
items.why_en: It demonstrates the use of transformer-based ICL in urban design, offering a data-driven way to improve walkability for older adults.

items.title_zh: PureTD：免搜索强化学习在双陆棋博彩游戏中达到接近最优水平
items.title_en: PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search
items.summary_zh: 该研究重新审视了Tesauro的TD-Gammon算法，在评估时不使用任何搜索的情况下进行双陆棋“钱局”（money games）学习。模型通过自我对弈的强化学习从零开始学习棋子走法和加倍骰子使用，仅需极少量手工编码逻辑，无需专家特征。实验表明，纯自我对弈强化学习足以训练出接近当前顶尖水平的模型，且在有加倍骰子的博彩局面中，该无搜索模型评估速度更快、实力显著优于开源引擎。这项工作展示了基于值函数的强化学习在棋类博弈中的潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source engine…
items.why_zh: 该研究表明纯自我对弈强化学习无需搜索即可达到接近最先进的博弈水平，对简化基于RL的博弈系统具有重要意义。
items.why_en: It shows that pure self-play RL can achieve near-SOTA backgammon play without evaluation-time search, simplifying RL-based game systems.

items.title_zh: 1/2-Tsallis-INF算法能否同样适用于最优臂识别？
items.title_en: Does 1/2-Tsallis-INF Also Work Well for Best-Arm Identification?
items.summary_zh: 在多臂老虎机问题中，遗憾最小化（RM）与最优臂识别（BAI）是两大基本目标。1/2-Tsallis-INF 是一种经典的“两全其美”FTRL算法，能够在随机环境中实现对数伪遗憾，并在对抗环境中保持极小极大最优遗憾，且无需预先知道环境类型。该研究探讨了同一算法在不额外引入探索机制的情况下，是否也能可靠地识别出最优臂。研究结果对于理解RM与BAI之间的兼容性具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Regret minimization (RM) and best-arm identification (BAI) are two fundamental objectives in multi-armed bandits. Among regret-minimizing algorithms, $1/2$-Tsallis-INF is a canonical best-of-both-worlds FTRL algorithm: it achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic bandits while retaining minimax-optimal regret in adversarial bandits, without knowing the environment in advance. This raises a natural question: can the same algorithm, without additional exploration, also identify the best arm reliably? We study this question in stochastic band…
items.why_zh: 该研究探讨了统一遗憾最小化与最优臂识别两大目标的可行性，有助于设计更高效的多臂老虎机算法。
items.why_en: It examines whether a single FTRL algorithm can serve both regret minimization and best-arm identification, potentially simplifying bandit algorithm design.

items.title_zh: 保证自适应模态获取：当策略选择自身校准组时
items.title_en: Guaranteed Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group
items.summary_zh: 多模态系统在推理时可能只拥有部分输入，并需付出成本获取其余输入。在自适应获取机制中，策略决定了最终观察到的输入组合，因此需要基于最终的输入模式给出统计保证。然而，常规条件校准假设分组映射独立于校准样本，而策略诱导的分组并不满足这一前提。该研究刻画了模式条件保证在何种条件下仍然成立，并提出了两种有限样本构造方法，包括无需阈值的路由方案。这项工作为带有获取成本的多模态推理提供了可靠的不确定性保证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A multimodal system may begin inference holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state the guarantee conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration normally assumes the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, which policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional guarantees remain valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing w…
items.why_zh: 该研究为多模态系统在动态获取输入时提供了有效的统计保证，对成本敏感的真实场景很有价值。
items.why_en: It provides valid uncertainty guarantees for adaptive multimodal acquisition, addressing a key challenge for cost-sensitive AI systems.

items.title_zh: 稀疏协作推理的隐私研究
items.title_en: A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference
items.summary_zh: 协作推理将模型部署在边缘设备与服务器之间，客户端需将中间激活传输给服务器，这既带来通信开销，也可能泄露输入隐私。近期研究通过激活稀疏化与熵编码来压缩传输数据，并有人直觉认为稀疏化还会因减少传输数值而提升隐私。该论文对这一直觉进行了实证检验，考察稀疏化在降低通信成本的同时，是否真正增强了隐私保护。研究结果对设计高效且安全的边缘-云协同推理方案具有参考价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test…
items.why_zh: 该研究检验了稀疏化提升隐私的常见假设，对边缘智能系统的安全通信设计有重要启示。
items.why_en: It tests a common assumption about sparsity and privacy in collaborative inference, informing secure edge-AI design.

items.title_zh: 推动开放可复现的关系学习：RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel与RPI发布
items.title_en: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$\alpha$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
items.summary_zh: Prior Labs发布了其在关系学习领域的首个公开版本，展示了其对开放科学的持续承诺。此次开源了三款软件工具：RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel和RPI，旨在通过社区反馈进一步开发，并加速该领域向有实际影响的研究迈进。由于仍处于早期阶段，本次α版本主要面向研究人员和早期应用者。长期以来关系学习虽已有多种数据集与任务，但社区在工具整合与可复现性方面仍面临挑战，此次发布有助于填补这一空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $\alpha$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the commu…
items.why_zh: 此次开源提供了关系学习社区急需的开放基础设施，有望降低研究门槛并促进可复现研究。
items.why_en: It provides much-needed open infrastructure for relational learning, potentially lowering barriers and fostering reproducibility.

items.title_zh: 带记忆的广义线性Bandits：更紧的遗憾界
items.title_en: Generalized Linear Bandits with Memory
items.summary_zh: 这项研究关注带记忆的广义线性Bandits问题，这是一种内生的非平稳设置，其中奖励通过一个有限记忆矩阵依赖于历史动作。作者在已有线性模型工作（Clerici等，2024）基础上，证明先前已知的T^(3/4)遗憾界来源于过于宽松的分析，并通过更精细的分析在线性情形下将遗憾率优化到√T。随后，他们将这一改进扩展到广义线性模型，并提出一种基于收缩置信区域的块式算法。该成果显著提升了此类问题的理论最优性，对在线决策研究有重要价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15848v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study generalized linear bandits with memory, an endogenous non-stationary setting in which rewards depend on past actions through a finite memory matrix. Building on prior work for linear models (Clerici et al., 2024), we show that the previously known $\tilde{O}(T^{3/4})$ regret bound stems from a loose analysis, and we provide a sharpened analysis that recovers a $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret rate in the linear case. We then extend this improvement to generalized linear models and propose a block-wise algorithm based on shrunken confidence…
items.why_zh: 该研究将带记忆Bandits的遗憾界从T^(3/4)改进到接近最优的√T，为在线决策理论提供了更紧的边界。
items.why_en: This work sharpens regret bounds for bandits with memory from T^{3/4} to nearly optimal √T, advancing online decision theory.

items.title_zh: 基于EEG的熟悉度预测：机器学习与深度学习模型基准测试
items.title_en: Automating Learner Assessment: Benchmarking Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for EEG-Based Familiarity Prediction
items.summary_zh: 客观评估学习效果仍是教育中的一大挑战。脑电图（EEG）为观察知识习得过程中的神经活动提供了直接且非侵入的途径，可用于捕捉认知熟悉度。这项研究在面孔（事实知识）和数学方程（概念知识）两个认知域中，系统评估了15种机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型在EEG熟悉度预测上的表现。研究利用23名参与者的连续EEG数据，提取功率谱等频谱特征，并对比各模型准确性。这项基准测试为基于EEG的自动化学习评估提供了重要参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16541v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Objective assessment of learning remains a fundamental challenge in education. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a direct, non-invasive window into the neural correlates of knowledge acquisition, including cognitive familiarity. This study benchmarks fifteen machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for EEG-based familiarity prediction across two cognitive domains: faces (factual knowledge) and mathematical equations (conceptual knowledge). Using continuous EEG data from 23 participants, we extract spectral features (Power Spectra…
items.why_zh: 为基于EEG的自动学习评估提供了大规模模型基准，有助于推动教育领域的客观学习监测。
items.why_en: It provides a comprehensive model benchmark for EEG-based learning assessment, enabling more objective monitoring in education.

items.title_zh: 评估随机嵌入表示下Fréchet Inception Distance的可信度
items.title_en: Evaluating the trustworthiness of the Fr\'echet Inception Distance with stochastic embedding representations
items.summary_zh: Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）是评估生成图像质量的常用指标，其前提是图像特征能够被在ImageNet1K自然图像上预训练的InceptionV3模型有效编码。然而在医学图像等场景中，这一假设往往并不成立。本文重点考察在随机嵌入表示下FID的可信度，并分析嵌入表示的随机性对该指标稳定性和有效性的影响。研究结果有助于更审慎地使用FID评估生成医学图像质量，也为生成式医学图像的质量评估方法提供了改进方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.21979v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Feature embeddings acquired from pretrained models are widely used in medical applications of deep learning to assess the characteristics of datasets; e.g. to determine the quality of synthetic, generated medical images. The Fr\'{e}chet Inception Distance (FID) is one popular synthetic image quality metric that relies on the assumption that the characteristic features of the data can be detected and encoded by an InceptionV3 model pretrained on ImageNet1K (natural images). While it is widely known that this makes it less effective for applica…
items.why_zh: FID是评估合成医学图像的重要指标，厘清其随机嵌入下的可信度对医学影像质量评估至关重要。
items.why_en: Since FID is key for evaluating synthetic medical images, assessing its trustworthiness under stochastic embeddings is critical for reliable quality evaluation.

items.title_zh: ODTlearn：用于预测和处方的最优决策树学习开源包
items.title_en: ODTlearn: A Package for Learning Optimal Decision Trees for Prediction and Prescription
items.summary_zh: ODTlearn是一个开源Python库，用于学习高风险预测和处方任务中的最优决策树，其核心基于前沿的混合整数优化（MIO）框架。当前版本提供四类方法：最优分类树、公平最优分类树、由观测数据学习的最优处方树，以及针对分布偏移具备鲁棒性的最优分类树。该库设计兼顾易用性与可靠性，便于研究者和从业者在关键决策中构建透明且可优化的模型。作为开源工具，它降低了最优决策树方法的采用门槛。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2307.15691v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: ODTlearn is an open source Python package that provides methods for learning optimal decision trees for high-stakes predictive and prescriptive tasks based on the state-of-the-art mixed-integer optimization (MIO) framework proposed in Aghaei et al. (2025). The current version of the package provides implementations for learning optimal classification trees, optimal fair classification trees, optimal prescriptive trees from observational data, and optimal classification trees robust to distribution shifts. We have designed the package to…
items.why_zh: 该开源包将前沿最优决策树方法集成为易用工具，有助于在高风险决策中实现透明、公平且健壮的机器学习。
items.why_en: This package makes state-of-the-art optimal decision tree methods easily accessible, supporting transparent, fair, and robust ML in high-stakes decisions.

items.title_zh: MiDAS：机器人辅助微创手术的多模态数据采集系统与数据集
items.title_en: MiDAS: A Multimodal Data Acquisition System and Dataset for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
items.summary_zh: 机器人辅助微创手术（RMIS）研究高度依赖多模态数据，但获取专有机器人遥测数据通常困难。研究者推出MiDAS，一个开源且平台无关的数据采集系统，能够在不同手术机器人上实现时间同步、非侵入的多模态数据采集。MiDAS集成了电磁与RGB-D手部追踪、脚踏板感知和手术视频录制，无需专有接口，并已在开源平台上验证。这一系统有望打破数据壁垒，推动RMIS领域多模态研究与跨平台协作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.12407v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Background: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RMIS) research increasingly relies on multimodal data, yet access to proprietary robot telemetry remains a major barrier. We introduce MiDAS, an open-source, platform-agnostic system enabling time-synchronized, non-invasive multimodal data acquisition across surgical robotic platforms. Methods: MiDAS integrates electromagnetic and RGB-D hand tracking, foot pedal sensing, and surgical video capturing without requiring proprietary robot interfaces. We validated MiDAS on the open-sourc…
items.why_zh: MiDAS以开源、平台无关的方式解决了手术机器人数据获取障碍，有望加速多模态手术AI研究。
items.why_en: MiDAS removes the proprietary data barrier with an open, platform-agnostic system, accelerating multimodal AI research in surgery.

items.title_zh: 生物成像深度学习：我们究竟学到了什么？
items.title_en: Deep Learning for BioImaging: What Are We Really Learning?
items.summary_zh: 表示学习显著推动了自然图像分析，使模型能够捕捉高层语义特征，但在显微成像中，现有方法究竟学到了什么仍不清楚。这项研究针对最常见的两类显微图像——细胞培养成像和组织成像——进行了系统性的表示学习分析。作者考察了与自然图像相比，现有模型是否未能学到有意义的语义表示，从而揭示了当前生物成像深度学习可能存在的本质局限。该工作为生物医学图像基础模型的发展提供了重要参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.13377v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Representation learning has driven major advances in natural image analysis by enabling models to acquire high-level semantic features. In microscopy imaging, however, it remains unclear what current representation learning methods really learn. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of representation learning for the two most widely used and broadly available microscopy data types, representing critical scales in biology: cell culture and tissue imaging. We investigate whether, in contrast to natural images, existing models fail t…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了深度表示学习在生物成像中的真实行为，对医学与生命科学中的AI应用有重要指导意义。
items.why_en: It clarifies what deep representation learning actually captures in bioimaging, informing reliable AI use in life sciences.

items.title_zh: MoRFI：单调稀疏自编码器特征识别
items.title_en: MoRFI: Monotonic Sparse Autoencoder Feature Identification
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在预训练阶段通过下一词预测获取大部分事实知识，而后续训练常引入超出参数知识的新事实，进而引发幻觉。已有研究发现，对新知识进行监督微调（SFT）可能加剧幻觉，但具体机制尚不明确。本研究针对闭卷问答进行受控微调实验，利用MoRFI（单调稀疏自编码器特征识别）方法，识别出与幻觉因果关联的潜在方向。这为理解模型微调后的幻觉产生机理提供了新的解释视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.26866v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire most of their factual knowledge during the pre-training stage, through next token prediction. Subsequent stages of post-training often introduce new facts outwith the parametric knowledge, giving rise to hallucinations. While it has been demonstrated that supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on new knowledge may exacerbate the problem, the underlying mechanisms are still poorly understood. We conduct a controlled fine-tuning experiment, focusing on closed-book QA, and identify latent directions causally impl…
items.why_zh: 该工作揭示了监督微调加剧LLM幻觉的潜在机制，为缓解幻觉提供了新的技术思路。
items.why_en: This work identifies causal latent mechanisms of hallucination during LLM fine-tuning, offering new ways to mitigate it.

items.title_zh: 参数更新稀疏的线性上下文Bandits：实用最优算法
items.title_en: Practical and Optimal Algorithm for Linear Contextual Bandits with Rare Parameter Updates
items.summary_zh: 这项研究聚焦参数更新稀疏的线性上下文Bandits问题：学习器只能在少量更新时刻将奖励反馈纳入参数估计，同时仍必须在线观察上下文并顺序决策。作者指出，许多“严格批处理”方法额外限制了区间内上下文自适应性，即区间内的动作策略不能依赖已实现的上下文/动作序列，这模糊了实际应用中的关键区别。文章提出一种实用且最优的算法，在保持计算效率的同时实现理论上的最优性能。该成果对于更新成本高的在线决策系统具有现实部署价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.00984v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study linear contextual bandits under rare parameter updates: the learner may incorporate reward feedback into its parameter estimate only at a small number of update times, while still observing contexts online and selecting actions sequentially. This viewpoint clarifies a practical distinction that is often blurred in the literature: many "strictly batched" methods additionally restrict within-interval context adaptivity, meaning that the action rule inside an interval cannot depend on the sequence of realized contexts/actions in t…
items.why_zh: 在实际系统中参数更新成本高，该算法在极低更新频率下仍保持最优性能，极具部署价值。
items.why_en: This algorithm maintains optimal performance even with rare parameter updates, making it highly practical for real-world deployment.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 18 日消息，科技媒体 videocardz 昨日（8 月 17 日）发布博文，报道称在 2026 年第 2 季度财报电话会议上， 华硕表示首批搭载英伟达 RTX Spark 的产品已被渠道合作伙伴订购一空。 作为首批推出 RTX Spark 平台产品的厂商 ，华硕表示搭载 NVIDIA RTX Spark 的 ProArt P16 与 ProArt P14 预售需求远超预期，面向零售商和分销商的首批配额已全部订完。 华硕联席 CEO 许先越表示，公司为首批产品准备的数量已全部被渠道伙伴预订，正持续向合作伙伴追加订单。这里的渠道伙伴包括第三方零售商和分销商。华硕未披露首批配额、预订量或追加订单的具体数值，因此无法据此判断实际销售规模。 IT之家此前报道，这两款笔记本是全球首批专为个人 AI 智能体打造的 Windows PC，可提供 1 PFLOPS（千万亿次浮点运算）的 AI 性能，可让创作者渲染超 90GB 的大型 3D 场景；并运行 1200 亿参数、100 万 Token 上下文的大语言模型。 规格方面，这两款笔记本内置 Blackwell 架构 RTX GPU，拥有 6144 个 CUDA 核心及第五代 Tensor Core（支持 FP4 精度），并通过 NVLink-C2C 技术与 20 核 Grace CPU 相连接。最高提供 128GB 统一内存…

ASUS did not disclose exact numbers but is adding orders to meet demand.

items.title_zh: Counterpoint：未来五年超 1.3 亿颗先进封装 AI 芯片出货，英特尔挑战台积电
items.title_en: Counterpoint: Over 130 Million Advanced-Packaging AI Chips to Ship in Five Years; Intel Challenges TSMC
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 18 日消息，市场研究机构 Counterpoint 今日发文，AI 加速器的出货量将大规模推动先进封装的需求： 预计未来五年内，将有超过 1.3 亿颗 GPU / AI ASIC 芯片采用先进封装的片上计算内存 ，从而创造近 2 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 13.51 万亿元人民币） 的计算收入。 报告认为，封装而非逻辑扩展已成为新的竞争战场，因为业界正努力突破内存壁垒、性能壁垒和铜墙（Copper Wall）这三大物理极限。 报告认为，HBM 对台积电 CoWoS 硅中介层的依赖带来了高昂的成本，包括厚封装、良率风险、产能限制和高废料成本，因此，这为可靠的替代方案创造了机会。 英特尔在三个方面为内存接口提供了一个理论上很有吸引力的架构解决方案： EMIB （其目前成熟的商用封装平台）、 ZAM （与软银的 SAIMEMORY 合作开发的近中期 HBM4 级挑战者）和 XBM （长期 BEOL 薄膜晶体管和串行 UCIe 重新设计）。 报告还称，台积电在大批量生产、成熟度和 JEDEC 标准生态系统锁定方面仍然领先，但在 CoWoS 的同类创新方面则处于劣势。因此，英特尔能否挑战 CoWoS 取决于其能否及时执行、获得生态系统支持（例如，与谷歌 / 联发科或一级内存合作伙伴合作），以及能否解决 EMIB、ZAM 和 XBM 在散热和集成方面的权衡问题。
items.summary_en: Counterpoint forecasts that over 130 million GPUs/AI ASICs using advanced packaging with on-chip memory will ship in the next five years, generating nearly $2 trillion in compute revenue. Packaging is becoming the new battleground. Intel's EMIB, ZAM, and XBM solutions challenge TSMC's CoWoS, while TSMC retains advantages in mass production and ecosystem maturity.
items.why_zh: 先进封装成为AI算力竞争新焦点，英特尔有机会挑战台积电的垄断地位。
items.why_en: Advanced packaging is the new frontier in AI compute, giving Intel a potential edge over TSMC's dominance.

items.title_zh: 外媒盘点微软 Win11 五年演变：切换任务栏位置，加速整合 AI 功能等
items.title_en: Windows 11 Over Five Years: Taskbar Changes, AI Integration, and More
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 18 日消息，科技媒体 Windows Central 昨日（8 月 17 日）发布博文，对比了 Windows 11 发布约 5 年间的前后变化差异。 IT之家注：微软于 2021 年 6 月 24 日首次公开展示 Windows 11 系统，首个正式版（21H2）于 2021 年 10 月 5 日发布。 过去 5 年间，微软通过年度功能更新、数十次累积更新和数千项漏洞修复，补回任务栏拖放、应用标签等功能，并扩展文件资源管理器、设置、搜索、多任务和辅助功能。 该媒体指出 Windows 11 首个版本存在诸多不足，例如文件资源管理器没有标签页；任务栏失去拖放、应用标签和“从不合并”等功能；许多高级设置仍会跳转至控制面板。 在体验方面，新版右键菜单打开部分选项需要额外一步点击。早期版本还出现动画迟滞、文件资源管理器响应慢、内存占用较高和新旧界面混杂等问题。 一、开始菜单 微软于 2021 年推出的首个 Windows 11 版本中，开始菜单处于固定状态，用户无法调整菜单大小，也无法完全隐藏推荐项。 2021 年版开始菜单 2026 年版本新增“小”“大”和“自动”3 种尺寸选项，并改进固定内容和最近内容的组织方式。 2026 年版开始菜单 二、任务栏 任务栏是首发版本争议最大的部分之一。微软于 2021 年移除了拖放、应用标签、“从不合并”选项，并将右键菜单缩减为…
items.summary_en: Windows Central reviewed Windows 11's five-year evolution since its 2021 debut. Microsoft has restored features like taskbar drag-and-drop and app labels, while improving File Explorer, Settings, and search. The OS now integrates more AI capabilities, with a more flexible Start menu and refined taskbar.
items.why_zh: 展示了Windows 11从初版不足到逐步成熟并加速AI整合的完整演进历程。
items.why_en: It highlights how Windows 11 matured over five years, fixing early issues and accelerating AI integration.

items.title_en: Apple's Camera-Equipped AirPods Leak in Demo, Enabling Visual Intelligence
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 18 日消息，根据 MacRumors 在 macOS Tahoe 26.7 RC 中发现的一段视频，证实苹果正在研发配备摄像头的 AirPods，而且这款产品似乎已经接近正式推出。 IT之家注意到，在这段简短的演示视频中，一名男子拿起一本书，让 AirPods 上的摄像头拍摄书名。画外音文字写道：“借助视觉智能，你所看到的世界都可以被保存。看到喜欢的东西？只要告诉我，我就能帮你保存下来，以便稍后查看。” AirPods 上的摄像头将把获取的信息提供给“视觉智能”（Visual Intelligence），Siri 则可以回答用户有关周围环境的问题，并记录相关信息。系统代码中还直接出现了在 AirPods 上设置“视觉智能”的相关提示。 如果头发遮挡了 AirPods 上的摄像头，用户还会收到提醒。系统提示写道：“为了获得有关周围环境中物体的最准确信息，请确保 AirPods 没有被遮挡。” 这款配备摄像头的 AirPods 内部代号为 B790，此前彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 也曾曝光过这一代号。Gurman 此前透露，这款 AirPods 最快可能在今年 9 月发布，因此苹果有可能在以 iPhone 为核心的秋季发布会上推出这款产品。届时，苹果预计还将推出 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max 以及可折叠 iPhone Ult…
items.summary_en: A video found in macOS Tahoe 26.7 RC reveals Apple is developing AirPods with cameras, likely near launch. The demo shows Visual Intelligence capturing objects and Siri answering environmental questions. Codenamed B790, they could debut as soon as September alongside new iPhones.

items.why_en: It signals Apple's push to extend Visual Intelligence to wearables, potentially redefining AirPods' role.

items.summary_en: Bloomberg data from 13F filings shows family offices in the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East hold at least $3.8 billion in SpaceX shares combined. Notable stakes include Nick Pritzker's $1.8 billion and others over $100 million, made weeks after SpaceX's IPO.
